reason: $24.99 is under a dollar a day, the lab report is on the page, and the empty-box guarantee makes one box a cheap test. Pre-counted sachets are handy when I'm travelling.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule? I'd also want to know I'm not overpaying versus a big bottle at the drugstore.
would_change_my_mind: If the launch price were gone and it was $29.99 with no coupon or bundle deal, I'd skip it and wait for a flash sale.
